ACT XXX OF 2017
ACT XXX OF 2017
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
An Act to amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 6th December, 2017]
No.PAS/Legis-B-25/2017,
dated 6.12.2017.---The Sindh Civil
Servants (Amendment) Bill, 2017 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Sindh on 02nd November, 2017 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on
30th November, 2017 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh Civil
Servants Act, 1973, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and Commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No. XIV of 1973
